story: Smile Lawn Care is a local lawn and landscape crew working Wilkes-Barre and the boroughs around it. Eric runs it, and Eric is usually the one who turns up to walk your property and write the estimate. The idea was never to be the biggest outfit in Luzerne County — it was to be the one that answers the phone, quotes in writing, and shows up on the day it said it would. If you read our reviews, that is the thread running through nearly all of them: people mention the punctuality and the communication before they mention the grass. We started on mowing and clean-ups, and most customers hand us the rest over time — bed maintenance, mulch, weed control and fertilizer, pressure washing, and the driveway once it starts snowing. It is one crew on one schedule, so nothing falls between two contractors. We are licensed and insured for residential and commercial work, and we currently hold a 5.0 rating across 37 Google reviews. In a market this size, that is the only marketing that has ever really mattered.
